coverLetter: I am writing to express my interest in a strategic finance / FP&A leadership role where rigorous planning, clear management reporting and commercial partnership drive better decisions. As a CMA and ACCA-qualified professional with 15+ years across Saudi Arabia and the MENA region — in retail, F&B franchising, mobility, fuel and energy, consulting and Big Four audit — I bring proven strength in budgeting, forecasting, capital appraisal and reporting automation. I have cut group reporting cycles by four weeks, reduced a monthly reporting lag from ten weeks to under six, and built a finance function from the ground up in partnership with PETRONAS directors and a Group CFO. I am based in Saudi Arabia and available to start immediately. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience aligns with your team's priorities.
